title: Diff row and header backgrounds stop at nested ANSI resets
observed: In the fresh 120x40 iTerm2 capture, added and removed diff row tints cover the line-number gutter but disappear before the sign, code, and trailing padding. The header panel tint similarly stops after its styled path. RenderDiffLines and diffHeaderRow wrap a background around independently styled spans containing full SGR resets; the committed diff-modified.styles.txt also records this sequence. Cross-checked in Terminal.app: the same visual defect is present.
expected: Added and removed row backgrounds and the diff header panel span the full content width. Compose foreground and background together per span, or otherwise preserve the background across inner resets; verify actual styled cells across the row.

fix.note: onRow re-applies the surface after every inner reset (RaiseRow's mechanism, generalised); verified in Terminal.app on the Mac mini
